description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter class 'ContentRowAdapter' for an Android app. The adapter renders a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontal list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure the row title remains visible when a child card gains focus, including custom scrolling logic within nested RecyclerViews.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: A ListAdapter that manages a list of ContentRow items, inflating item views and binding data.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RowVH ViewHolder for the given parent.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at the given position.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for a single content row, manages references to title and inner recycler view, and sets focus behavior.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list of ContentRow objects to the adapter.
